title: AC1027 HEADER suffix retry after latest user unlock
scope: Retry the existing AC1027 Cover source with the installed ODA File Converter after the user reported unlocking the Mac again; determine whether the invocation reaches document processing.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; no DWG/DXF fixture was created or added to the repository.

converter.result: ABORT (SIGABRT, shell status 134) during PasteBoard/XPC initialization; stdout empty; no document processing or output file.
converter.stderrExcerpt: PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.clipboard [-4960]; PasteBoard: Error creating pasteboard: com.apple.pasteboard.find [-4960]; Connection Invalid error for service com.apple.hiservices-xpcservice.

decision: The latest user-reported unlock did not change the direct CLI launch failure. Do not repeat this invocation while its launch environment and method remain unchanged. Suffix bytes remain unclaimed, suffix analysis remains unqualified, and strict output remains refused. Continue independent local implementation; retry only if a functioning GUI, materially changed invocation environment, or independent converter session becomes available.
